reason: The selected-row cache preserves enough information for a later low-rank residual fit but cannot train or evaluate the mixed AFF3 attention block. Full attention and recurrent linear attention require the complete 64-token hidden-state sequence, so promotion to all-layer mixed training would have been invalid.
next_design: Store one atomic full-context input/output BF16 shard per layer. This retains attention context, provides a restart boundary after every layer, avoids rewriting a monolithic checkpoint, and lets later training load one layer shard at a time.
status_boundary: v41 is neither a completed cache nor a zero score. Its frozen gate did not run, and it provides no quality, model, runtime, novelty, or breakthrough evidence.
